_comment: Where the agent looks for things. These are the same share paths the packaging team uses; the agent only READS from them.
_WorkRoot: reports, evaluation sheets and the audit log of every AI call land here
_RepositoryPath: incoming orders (the folder picker starts here)
_PredecessorPath: live packages - used to find the previous version of an app
_StageSourceLocal: copy a network source folder locally once before reading it
